issues.note: The rock arch r0 (and copies r3, r6) is a slab peaking at about 6 px. The crest along the lit upper edge should reach about 18-20 px, with the band averaging about 12 px (analysis: 12.5 mean, 21.5 max), and slope down to the ground at the arch's outer ends.

The cross-section is a flat-topped plate with vertical sides and a thin lip. It should be a rounded, faceted rock mound, roughly a half-cylinder along the arch: highest along the highlighted crest, sloping down to the outer edge, and dropping into the undercut on the inner (concave) side. The crest highlight and side shading should then come from the form.

The dark shadowed band under the inside of each arch (the cave opening) is only painted on a flat surface. It should be real geometry: the inner face recessed back about 6-10 px under the crest as an overhang (or a through-opening), so the shadow falls into it.

A saw-tooth fringe of 1-2 px triangular spikes from the displacement noise runs along the inner and lower edges, and roughens the top edge in panel 2. Remove the fine noise at the edges, keep the outline smooth and following the sprite, and turn the edge into the sloped flank of the mound.

The sprite's large boulder facets, separated by dark cracks along the top of each arch, have no matching relief; the surface noise is random. Replace the noise with a few large rounded lobes, each raised 2-4 px, following the facets, and cut the crack lines about 1-2 px deep.
Faint lines cross the rock at piece boundaries from the game camera (e.g. a vertical line through the top arch). Weld the vertices or match the normals across pieces so the joins disappear.

Lit from above, the rock reads greyer and duller than the sprite's warm tan, even though the flat colours match (dE 2.3). Check the material's specular/roughness (and the base tint) so the lit top view keeps the sprite's warm tan.

The small rock chunks r1/r2 (and their copies r4/r5, r7/r8) at the arch ends are 1.3-1.6 px plates. The analysis puts r1 at about 5 px, so make them small rounded boulders of about that height, blending into the arch's sloping ends.

reasons.cohesion: The 24 pieces meet cleanly (seam mean dz 0.004 px, max 0.08 px, none over 1 px; the 77 gap samples aren't visible), and the three overlapping copies show no steps. Faint lines cross the rock at piece boundaries from the game camera (e.g. a vertical line through the top arch in panel 9), likely from normals that don't match across pieces. Reads as one object with small seams, so 4.
reasons.detail: The boulder facets, the dark cracks between them and the shadowed band inside the arch exist only as painted texture. The relief is fine random noise that doesn't follow the sprite's big boulder blocks or crack lines, and reads as fuzz. The defining detail, the hollow or undercut under the inner side of the arch, isn't cut in. Target: an overhang under the crest, and a few large rounded lobes 2-4 px proud following the crack lines, with the cracks cut 1-2 px deep. Mostly missing in relief, so 2.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) the painted texture carries it, so it's recognisable as the rock-arch tile. But the lighting shows thin rock decals with jagged edges, not standing arches, and the cave under the arch reads as paint. Recognisable, so 3.
reasons.overall: It matches the sprite from above only because it's a textured plate. The geometry is a 6 px slab with a saw-tooth edge, and it needs to become a rounded rock mass cresting at about 18-20 px, with a real undercut under the inner side and big lobes following the cracks. That's a geometry rebuild, not a tweak, so poor: 2.

assembly-newshb-115-current.acceptedFromCommittee: 2026-10-28: the user agreed with all the committee findings

issues.note: The twin blue columns (r19 left, r3 right, with the grid tops r1/r4) top out at about 6-7 px, only about 4 px above the deck. In the sprite they're about 20 px wide round tubes with a highlight stripe; raise them to about 15-20 px (at least a full half-cylinder standing about 10 px above the deck).

The blue ring r2 is a squashed torus whose tube stands about 3.5 px above the deck (top at about 6 px). The sprite's ring tube is about 12 px wide with strong top highlights; give it a near-circular section, about 10-12 px tall.

The column bodies are rounded-edge slabs with flat lids. Make them cylinders lying along the screen's vertical axis, so the sprite's highlight stripe and dark right edge come from the lighting, with the grid plates r1/r4 following the curved top.

The side gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44 and their mirrors) are ball-and-capsule chains about 6-7 px tall. The sprite shows straight stacks of cylinder segments of stepped width, about 10 px wide at the base; rebuild them as stacked cylinders about 10-13 px tall.
There is red along both sides of each gun stack in the diff: the model's segments are narrower than the sprite's (coverage about 0.6-0.7). Widen each segment to its sprite width.

The main deck r42 is a 2-3 px slab. The sprite's lit-edge stripes on the wings say the plates are bevelled and stacked; make it about 5-6 px thick at the centre, bevelling down to about 2 px at the purple wing tips.

The dark strip right of the ring and down the right side (r41, near-black in the sprite, dE 44.5) is modelled as light grey striped deck. Make it a dark channel cut 2-3 px into the deck, in the sprite's shadow colour.

The lamps r25/r27 are flat light cornflower blue (dE 38-48). The sprite's are deep saturated electric blue with a near-white cyan core, so use an emissive bright blue with a lighter centre. The columns and ring should also shift from flat steel-blue toward the sprite's navy with cyan highlights.

The outer gun stacks (r17/r37, r32 and their mirrors) are centred near deck level, so their lower balls hang about 1-1.5 px below the deck's underside (also visible in panel 5). Raise them so nothing goes below 0 px.
Inside the ring, the dark cavity r53/r57 is only about 2 px below the hull. The sprite shows a deep dark well; cut it about 4-6 px below the hull top.
The ribbed grille r35 on the right column shows as a row of separate bumps floating about 1 px above the column top. Seat the ribs into the column surface so they follow its curve.
The sprite's 1-2 px dark outline along the outer purple wing edges (r55/r56) is missed (red rim in the diff). Extend the wing edges about 1 px with a dark bevel.

reasons.cohesion: seams: mean step 0.066 px, max 1.2 px, 12 samples over 1 px, no gaps. The ring sits cleanly on the deck and the columns meet the ring without visible steps. The faults are small: the outer gun stacks (r17/r37, r32 and their mirrors) hang about 1-1.5 px below the deck's underside in both elevations, and they stand beside the wings rather than visibly mounting on them. The r35 grille ribs also float above the right column. Both scored 4.
reasons.detail: Most of the sprite's small detail is modelled in relief. That includes the 3x3 grid greebles on the column tops (r1/r4), the ribbed grilles r9/r40/r35, the two square deck hatches (cut in), the stepped block r52/r54 inside the ring, the arc grooves on the lower deck r50/r51, and the thin rods r20 between the columns. Missing or shallow: the dark channel r41 down the right side (painted light grey, not cut in), the dark well inside the ring (r53/r57, only about 2 px deep), and the many thin panel lines on the lower hull r42. The ribbed grille r35 also floats as a row of bumps about 1 px above the right column in panel 5. Both scored 4.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it is clearly this boss section: columns, ring, lamps and gun stacks are all where the sprite has them. Everything is low relief, though, so the columns and ring look like decals on a flat plate rather than glossy standing blue tubes, and the gun stacks look like strings of beads. Raising the columns and ring is what would make it read as 3D. Both scored 3.
reasons.overall: A complete, well-detailed assembly whose main fault is flatness: the defining blue columns and ring are a quarter to a third of the height they need. Fix in this order: make the columns and ring round tubes (about 15-20 px and 10-12 px tall), rebuild the gun stacks as full-width stacked cylinders, thicken the deck and recess r41, then correct the blues. Both scored 3; with heights and colours fixed it could be a 4-5.
reasons.profile: The two biggest parts have the wrong profile. The columns are flat-topped slabs with rounded ends (boxes in panels 6 and 7), not half-cylinders, so the sprite's highlight stripe and dark right edge don't come from the lighting. The ring is a torus squashed to a flat oval section. The lamps are proper ellipsoid domes, the ribbed pipes r9/r40 are round, and the stepped centre block and the hatches are correctly flat. The members disagreed on the gun stacks: Opus called them proper lathed cylinders, and Fable called them bead chains of balls and capsules where the sprite shows stacked cylinder segments of stepped width. Panels 7 and 9 show ball joints between capsule bodies, so they read somewhat beaded. Both scored 2.
reasons.silhouette: The layout matches the sprite: twin blue columns (r19/r3, with the grid tops r1/r4), the blue ring r2, the two lamps r25/r27, the four side gun stacks and the purple-edged deck are all in place (silhouette_iou 0.908). Of the 657 missed px, most are along the gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44), whose segments are narrower than the sprite's (red beside each stack in panel 4), plus a 1-2 px dark edge along the purple wing edges r55/r56. Colour is the bigger problem (colour_dE_mean 25.3, yellow over most of panel 4). The lamps r25/r27 are flat cornflower blue where the sprite has deep electric blue with a near-white core (dE 38-48), the dark strip r41 right of the ring is painted light grey, and the columns are a flatter steel-blue than the sprite's navy with cyan highlights. Opus gave 4 and Fable 3; I scored 3 because both the gun-stack outline and several colours are visibly off.
reasons.volume: The whole 116 x 84 px boss is only 8.25 px tall (height_to_width 0.084), and the deck r42 is a 2-3 px slab. In panels 5 and 6 the twin columns top out at about 6-7 px, only about 4 px above the deck. The sprite shows them about 20 px wide with a highlight stripe, so as round tubes they should stand about 15-20 px. The ring r2 tube is about 12 px wide in the sprite but stands only about 3.5 px above the deck (top near 6 px); it should be about 10-12 px tall. The gun stacks are about 6-7 px; Fable suggests about 13 px. The lamp domes, about 6 px on a 12 px footprint, already meet the rubric's half-diameter rule. Both scored 2.

chair.summary: The two defining parts are flat. The twin blue columns (about 4 px above the deck) and the ring (about 3.5 px) should be round tubes about 15-20 px and 10-12 px tall. Next, rebuild the gun stacks as full-width stacked cylinders, thicken the deck to about 5 px and cut the dark r41 channel. Then fix the blues (lamps especially) and lift the gun stacks above the deck's underside.

issues.note: The two blue towers (r19/r22, with r3 between) top out at 7-8 px on the ruler; the sprite's 26 px wide columns with a bright left highlight stripe are round pipes and should stand about 20-26 px.
Tower bodies are rounded-edge slabs with a flat top; cross-section should be a half-cylinder so the sprite's highlight stripe and dark right edge come from the lighting.
Blue loop r2 is a torus 3-6 px tall; its tube is ~15 px wide in the sprite, so the torus tube should be ~12-15 px tall.
Pods r25/r27 are 6 px domes on a 12 px footprint; sprite's glossy bulge calls for ~8-10 px, more than half the width.

Side gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44, and mirrored r23-r31) are chains of balls and capsules ~6 px tall; sprite shows straight stacks of cylinder segments of stepped width, ~10 px wide and ~13 px tall. Rebuild as stacked cylinders.
Red outline along both gun stacks: model segments are narrower than the sprite's cylinders; widen each segment to its sprite width (coverage 0.6-0.7 now).
Pods are light cornflower blue (dE 38-48); sprite is deep saturated electric blue with a white specular. Towers and loop are also a flatter steel-blue than the sprite's navy.
A ball of a gun stack hangs ~1 px below the 0 px base line; nothing should go below the hull plane.
Inside the loop the dark cavity r53/r57 is only ~2 px lower than the hull; sprite shows a deep dark well, cut it 4-6 px below the hull.

reasons.cohesion: Seams are tight (mean dz 0.07 px, max 1.2 px, no gaps); in panels 7/8 the loop sits cleanly on the hull and the towers meet the loop without visible steps. The only cohesion flaws are a ball of one gun stack hanging below the base plane in panel 5 and the gun stacks floating beside the wings rather than mounting on them. Reads as one object.
reasons.detail: Most details exist in relief: the 3x3 grille blocks r1/r4 on the tower tops, the ribbed pipes r9/r40 (visible as a toothed bar in panel 5), the dark side windows r46/r48 as dark recessed panels, the diagonal hull grooves on r50/r51, the stepped block r52/r54 inside the loop and the thin rods r20 between the towers. Missing are the sprite's many thin panel lines on the lower hull r42 and the dark cavity inside the loop (r53/r57) which is only ~2 px deep where the sprite reads as a deep well. Good coverage; a few recesses could be deeper.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it is clearly this boss: twin towers, loop, pods and side guns are all where the sprite has them. But everything is a low relief, so the towers and loop look like painted shapes on a plate rather than standing structures, and the gun stacks look like strings of beads. Raising the towers, loop and pods would make this read as the sprite in 3D.
reasons.overall: A complete, well-detailed assembly whose main fault is flatness: every major part is 2-4x too low. Fix the tower, loop and pod heights and the gun-stack profiles and the colours, and this would be a 4-5.
reasons.profile: The loop r2 is a proper torus and the pods are domes, which is right in kind though too shallow. The towers are rounded-edge slabs rather than half-cylinders: in panel 5 their top is a flat line at 7-8 px, where the sprite's highlight stripe calls for a round cross-section. The side gun stacks are chains of balls and capsules (panels 7/8 show dumbbells) where the sprite shows straight stacks of cylinder segments of stepped widths, so they read lumpy rather than mechanical. The ribbed pipes r9/r40 are correctly cylindrical.
reasons.silhouette: Outline IoU 0.908 with 657 px missed, almost all on the side gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44) which are thinner in the model than the sprite's cylinder segments, and on the purple fins r0/r5/r6 at the tower tops. Colour dE is 25 and panel 4 is yellow over nearly the whole body: the blue pods r25/r27 are a light cornflower blue where the sprite is deep electric blue, the towers (r19/r22) are a flat steel-blue without the sprite's navy-with-cyan-highlight, and the lower hull greys are a shade lighter than the sprite. fable.summary: Flat overall: towers, loop, pods and gun stacks are a quarter of the height the sprite implies, with the towers (8 px vs ~24) the worst. Second, the gun stacks are lumpy bead chains instead of stacked cylinders and are too thin. Third, the blues are off-palette (dE 25 overall).

issues.note: The twin blue columns (r1/r3/r4, left and right) top out about 6.5-7 px above ground, only about 4 px above the deck, with flat tops. In the sprite they're about 20 px wide round tubes with a centre highlight stripe; they should be round in section and about 15-20 px tall.

The blue 'lips' ring is a squashed torus whose tube stands about 3.5 px above the deck (top at about 6 px) with an oval section. The sprite's ring tube is about 12 px wide with strong top highlights; it should have a near-circular section, about 10-12 px tall.

The column bodies read as boxes with rounded ends and flat lids (grid greeble on a flat top). They should be cylinders lying along the screen's vertical axis, with the grid plates following the curved top.

The main deck (r42) is a 2-3 px slab, mean 2.9 px. The sprite's lit-edge stripes on the wings say the plates are bevelled and stacked; make the deck about 5-6 px thick at the centre, bevelling down to about 2 px at the purple wing tips.

The dark strip right of the ring and down the right side (r41, near-black in the sprite, dE 44.5) is modelled as light grey striped deck. It should be a dark channel cut 2-3 px into the deck, matching the sprite's shadow colour.
The blue lamps (r25 left, r27 right) are flat mid-blue ellipsoids (dE 38-48). The sprite's lamps are bright blue with a near-white cyan core; give them an emissive bright blue with a lighter centre.

The outer side guns (r17/r37 and their pairs) are centred near deck level, so their lower halves hang about 1.5 px below the deck's underside. Raise them so they sit on the deck (bottom at about 0 px, top at about 8-9 px).

The ribbed grille (r35) on the right column shows as a row of separate bumps floating about 1 px above the column top in the side elevation. Seat the ribs into the column's surface so they follow its curve.
The sprite's 1-2 px dark outline along the outer purple wing edges (r55/r56) and the column sides is missing (the red rim in the diff). Extend the wing edges about 1 px, with a dark bevel.

reasons.cohesion: seams: mean step 0.066 px, max 1.2 px, 12 samples over 1 px and no gaps, so the 15 pieces mostly meet cleanly and read as one deck. The visible faults are that the outer side guns hang about 1.5 px below the deck's underside (front elevation, below the 0 px line) and the grille ribs float above the right column. Small steps only, so 4.
reasons.detail: Most of the sprite's small detail is modelled: the grid greebles on the column tops, the ribbed grille strips beside the columns, the two square deck hatches (cut in, as panel 7 shows), the stepped centre block, the arc grooves on the lower deck and the small lamp highlights. Missing: the dark recessed channel r41 down the right side (painted light grey, not cut in). The ribbed grille r35 also sits as a row of bumps floating about 1 px above the right column's top in panel 5. That's a 4.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it is clearly this boss section: twin columns, ring, lamps and guns all read. But it looks like a decal on a flat plate: the ring and columns throw almost no shading and don't look like round blue tubes, unlike the glossy cylinders the sprite shows. Recognisable but not convincingly 3D, so 3.
reasons.overall: Outline, layout and detail are good, and the fix is mostly re-heighting: make the twin columns and the ring round tubes about as tall as they're wide, thicken the deck to about 5 px, and darken and recess r41. As it stands the defining blue tubes are flat, so it is OK as a start (3) but not shippable.
reasons.profile: The twin columns (r1/r3/r4) have a cyan highlight stripe and dark edges in the sprite, so they're round tubes, but the model makes them flat-topped slabs with rounded ends (boxes in panel 6). The ring is a torus squashed to a flat oval section, about 3.5 px tall for a 12 px wide tube, where it should be about circular. The side guns are proper lathed round cylinders and the lamps are proper ellipsoid domes, and the stepped centre block and hatches are correctly flat. Profiles are mixed, but the two biggest parts are wrong, so 2.
reasons.silhouette: The top view (panel 2) lines up with the sprite: twin blue columns, the blue 'lips' ring, the two blue lamps, the four side guns and the purple-edged deck are all in place, and silhouette_iou is 0.908. What is lost is the sprite's 1 px dark outline along the purple wing edges and column sides (the red rim in panel 4, 657 px missed). The colours are off in places: the dark shadow strip right of the ring (r41) is light grey deck in the model, and the lamps r25/r27 are flat mid-blue where the sprite has bright blue with a near-white core (dE 38-48), so colour_dE_mean is 25.3. That makes it a 4, not a 5.
reasons.volume: The whole assembly peaks at 8.25 px over a 116 x 84 px footprint (height_to_width 0.084). The front elevation (panel 6) shows the deck as a 2-3 px slab, the ring only about 3.5 px above the deck (top near 6 px) and the twin columns topping out near 7 px. The columns are about 20 px wide and the ring tube about 12 px wide, and both are drawn as round tubes, so they should stand about 15-20 px and about 10-12 px tall. Only the side guns (top near 7 px, about 8 px wide) and the lamp domes (about 5 px for a 10 px lamp) are about right, so most of the mass reads too low.

opus.summary: Outline and greebling are good, but the two defining parts are flat: the twin blue columns (about 4 px above the deck) and the ring (about 3.5 px) should be round tubes about 15-20 px and 10-12 px tall. Next, thicken the deck to about 5 px with bevels and cut the dark r41 channel into it. Then fix the lamp colour and lift the side guns so they don't hang below the deck.

issues.note: The twin blue columns (r19 left, r3 right, with the grid tops r1/r4) top out at about 6-7 px, only about 4 px above the deck. The blue ring r2 is a squashed torus whose tube stands about 3.5 px above the deck (top at about 6 px). The sprite's ring tube is about 12 px wide with strong top highlights; give it a near-circular section, about 10-12 px tall.

The column bodies are rounded-edge slabs with flat lids. Make them cylinders lying along the screen's vertical axis, so the sprite's highlight stripe and dark right edge come from the lighting, with the grid plates r1/r4 following the curved top.

The side gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44 and their mirrors) are ball-and-capsule chains about 6-7 px tall. The sprite shows straight stacks of cylinder segments of stepped width, about 10 px wide at the base; rebuild them as stacked cylinders about 10-13 px tall.
There is red along both sides of each gun stack in the diff: the model's segments are narrower than the sprite's (coverage about 0.6-0.7). Widen each segment to its sprite width.

The main deck r42 is a 2-3 px slab. The sprite's lit-edge stripes on the wings say the plates are bevelled and stacked; make it about 5-6 px thick at the centre, bevelling down to about 2 px at the purple wing tips.

The dark strip right of the ring and down the right side (r41, near-black in the sprite, dE 44.5) is modelled as light grey striped deck. Make it a dark channel cut 2-3 px into the deck, in the sprite's shadow colour.

The lamps r25/r27 are flat light cornflower blue (dE 38-48). The sprite's are deep saturated electric blue with a near-white cyan core, so use an emissive bright blue with a lighter centre. The columns and ring should also shift from flat steel-blue toward the sprite's navy with cyan highlights.

The outer gun stacks (r17/r37, r32 and their mirrors) are centred near deck level, so their lower balls hang about 1-1.5 px below the deck's underside (also visible in panel 5). Raise them so nothing goes below 0 px.

The sprite's 1-2 px dark outline along the outer purple wing edges (r55/r56) is missed (red rim in the diff). Extend the wing edges about 1 px with a dark bevel.

assembly-newshb-115-current.notes: The two defining parts are flat. The twin blue columns (about 4 px above the deck) and the ring (about 3.5 px) should be round tubes about 15-20 px and 10-12 px tall. reasons.cohesion: seams: mean step 0.066 px, max 1.2 px, 12 samples over 1 px, no gaps. The ring sits cleanly on the deck and the columns meet the ring without visible steps. The faults are small: the outer gun stacks (r17/r37, r32 and their mirrors) hang about 1-1.5 px below the deck's underside in both elevations, and they stand beside the wings rather than visibly mounting on them. The r35 grille ribs also float above the right column. Both scored 4.
reasons.detail: Most of the sprite's small detail is modelled in relief. That includes the 3x3 grid greebles on the column tops (r1/r4), the ribbed grilles r9/r40/r35, the two square deck hatches (cut in), the stepped block r52/r54 inside the ring, the arc grooves on the lower deck r50/r51, and the thin rods r20 between the columns. Missing or shallow: the dark channel r41 down the right side (painted light grey, not cut in), the dark well inside the ring (r53/r57, only about 2 px deep), and the many thin panel lines on the lower hull r42. The ribbed grille r35 also floats as a row of bumps about 1 px above the right column in panel 5. Both scored 4.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it is clearly this boss section: columns, ring, lamps and gun stacks are all where the sprite has them. Everything is low relief, though, so the columns and ring look like decals on a flat plate rather than glossy standing blue tubes, and the gun stacks look like strings of beads. Raising the columns and ring is what would make it read as 3D. Both scored 3.
reasons.overall: A complete, well-detailed assembly whose main fault is flatness: the defining blue columns and ring are a quarter to a third of the height they need. Fix in this order: make the columns and ring round tubes (about 15-20 px and 10-12 px tall), rebuild the gun stacks as full-width stacked cylinders, thicken the deck and recess r41, then correct the blues. Both scored 3; with heights and colours fixed it could be a 4-5.
reasons.profile: The two biggest parts have the wrong profile. The columns are flat-topped slabs with rounded ends (boxes in panels 6 and 7), not half-cylinders, so the sprite's highlight stripe and dark right edge don't come from the lighting. The ring is a torus squashed to a flat oval section. The lamps are proper ellipsoid domes, the ribbed pipes r9/r40 are round, and the stepped centre block and the hatches are correctly flat. The members disagreed on the gun stacks: Opus called them proper lathed cylinders, and Fable called them bead chains of balls and capsules where the sprite shows stacked cylinder segments of stepped width. Panels 7 and 9 show ball joints between capsule bodies, so they read somewhat beaded. Both scored 2.
reasons.silhouette: The layout matches the sprite: twin blue columns (r19/r3, with the grid tops r1/r4), the blue ring r2, the two lamps r25/r27, the four side gun stacks and the purple-edged deck are all in place (silhouette_iou 0.908). Of the 657 missed px, most are along the gun stacks (r17/r18, r37/r38, r32/r33, r44), whose segments are narrower than the sprite's (red beside each stack in panel 4), plus a 1-2 px dark edge along the purple wing edges r55/r56. Colour is the bigger problem (colour_dE_mean 25.3, yellow over most of panel 4). The lamps r25/r27 are flat cornflower blue where the sprite has deep electric blue with a near-white core (dE 38-48), the dark strip r41 right of the ring is painted light grey, and the columns are a flatter steel-blue than the sprite's navy with cyan highlights. Opus gave 4 and Fable 3; I scored 3 because both the gun-stack outline and several colours are visibly off.
reasons.volume: The whole 116 x 84 px boss is only 8.25 px tall (height_to_width 0.084), and the deck r42 is a 2-3 px slab. In panels 5 and 6 the twin columns top out at about 6-7 px, only about 4 px above the deck. The sprite shows them about 20 px wide with a highlight stripe, so as round tubes they should stand about 15-20 px. The ring r2 tube is about 12 px wide in the sprite but stands only about 3.5 px above the deck (top near 6 px); it should be about 10-12 px tall. The gun stacks are about 6-7 px; Fable suggests about 13 px. The lamp domes, about 6 px on a 12 px footprint, already meet the rubric's half-diameter rule. Both scored 2.

issues.note: The brown pods (r39/r41/r45 left, r40/r44/r46 right), about 20-23 px wide, top out at 4.8-5.9 px. The sprite's strong round shading makes them domed shells: make them about 10-12 px tall, rounded like an egg cut lengthwise.

The black drums (r26/r28 left, r27/r29 right), about 15 px wide, are 5.3 px tall and lens-flat. They're round in the sprite: make them cylinders lying across, about 10 px tall.

The four turrets (r23, r24, r42, r43) are flat stacked plates about 4.1 px tall. Stack them: a base plate about 3 px, a round body/cage raised to about 7-8 px, and the tan muzzle at the sprite-bottom end as a tapered barrel about 3 px thick.

The turrets are pale beige/tan (dE 24.9). The sprite's turret frames are copper-brown with dark outlines and blue windows. Darken the frames to the sprite's brown and make the windows a brighter blue.

The red tube row (r51-r68), about 6-7 px wide each, is 3.0 px tall. Fable accepts that as a half-cylinder, but the rubric's round part is about as tall as it is wide: make them about 5-6 px tall half-capsules, or about 4-5 px if they're sunk into 1-2 px recessed slots in the deck.

The two black squares r13/r15 are painted flat at floor level (mean 0.42 px). The sprite shows pits: cut them about 3 px into the deck with dark walls, which needs the deck r14 to be at least about 3 px thick there.
On each top dome, the vertical white slot holding the two red lights is painted flat. Cut the slot about 1-2 px into the dome.
The twelve red lights r1-r12 on the domes read dull or pink (dE 43 each). Make them the sprite's bright red, as 2 px round bumps rather than flat dots.

reasons.cohesion: The 22 pieces sit flush (seams mean 0.12 px, max 1.56 px, 52 of 784 samples over 1 px, no gaps), and the steps over 1 px are at the dome and pod bases, where they read as intentional. The deck r14 is very thin (mean 0.63 px) with no visible edge, so the machinery sits on a sheet, but nothing steps or floats. 4.
reasons.detail: The rich detail is there: two red lights per dome, turret cages with red side knobs, a tan muzzle stub under each turret, a red band and badge on the brown pods, and the deck tile texture. Much of it is painted rather than in relief. The black squares r13/r15 sit flat at floor level (actual mean 0.42 px against the deck's 0.63 px), not cut in as pits as Opus's 'cut-through holes' implied; the chair checked panel 7. The white slot holding the dome lights is flat, the gems' lit swirl is missing, and the tubes don't sit in recessed slots. Opus gave 3 and Fable 4; I took 3 because the sprite's recesses are painted on.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) the chair agrees with Opus: the rows of domes, the turrets, the red gems, the brown pods and the tube bank all read clearly as the sprite brought into 3D, with some roundness from the shading. The flatness shows mostly at the 3/4 angles (panel 7), and the dull reds weaken the punch slightly. Fable gave 3 for 'a painted floor with low bumps'; I scored 4.
reasons.overall: Outline, layout, detail and the game-camera read are good. The main problem is height: every raised component is a third to a half of its target, with the round parts squashed into lenses. Raising the domes, pods, drums, turrets and gems, then fixing the turret, gem and light colours, would make this a 4-5. 3.
reasons.profile: Part of it is right: the turret cages are boxy (correct), the tubes are acceptable rounded half-capsules, and the deck is flat. But the domes (about 24 x 3.7 px), the brown pods and the black drums (about 15 x 5 px) are squashed into lenses, and the gems are flat bevelled slabs where the sprite shows a rounded glowing pillow. Opus gave 2 ('round things flat'), Fable 3 ('right kind, squashed'). I took 3 because it's genuinely mixed; most of the squash belongs to volume.
reasons.silhouette: The outline is exact (IoU 1.0, 0 missed, 4 extra px): the deck r14, both black squares and every component are where the sprite has them. Colour drifts by part (dE 13.5 overall). reasons.volume: Everything sits under 6 px (max 5.88 px, h/w 0.04). Opus gave 4 and Fable 3; I took 3 because 'small seams or steps' is what the sheet shows, though nothing reads as a separate piece.
reasons.detail: Nearly every sprite detail is modelled: the grille ribs on r2, the twin turrets r0/r1 with caps, the framed side panels r24/r25 with engraved lines, the vent slats r35/r38, the blue stripes r27/r29, the angled pipes, the bolts along the wing roots, and the framed rear block r50/r56. The relief is shallow, though: r24/r25 sit only ~1.4 px below the pod top, and the engraved lines and vent slats are close to painted. Two dark areas are filled when they should be pits: the well r8 around the eye (3.1 px, should be ~0.5-1 px) and the slot r50 between the lower engines (2.9 px). Both members gave 4.
reasons.game: In the game view (panel 9) it clearly reads as this ship: the outline, the blue decks, the grey plates and the eye-in-a-U-bar composition all match. The flatness shows a little at this tilt: the U-bar and arms read as low plates or decals, not tubes, and the eye looks shallow. Both gave 4; raising the round parts would make it a 5.
reasons.overall: The top view is close to ship quality and nearly all the detail is there, but on a 180 px ship that tops out at 8 px every round part is half height or less, so the 3/4 views read as a decal. Opus gave 3 and Fable 4; I took 3 because flatness is the failure the rubric is built around and it's this model's main problem. Raise the arms, U-bar, eye and engines, sink the well r8, and weld the eye seam, and it's a 4-5.
reasons.profile: The flat parts are right: the pods are bevelled plates with sloped blue tops, and the panels r24/r25 are flat. The round parts are modelled round but squashed: the arms r17/r18 are capsules ~5 px tall on a ~10-14 px width with the highlight stripe painted on, the U-bar r28 is a low swelling ~1 px above the deck, and the eye is a squashed ellipsoid that rises only ~2.5-3.5 px. The lower engines r41-r43 are flat slabs with grooves where the sprite's horizontal highlight bands describe round barrel ends. Mixed, so 3 (Opus 2, Fable 3). Making the arms, U-bar, eye and engines as tall as they're wide would earn a 4-5.
reasons.silhouette: From above the 24 pieces line up with the sprite almost everywhere: IoU 0.968 (223 px missed, 146 extra) and colour dE 8. The grille plate r2, the side pods, the U-bar r28, the blue arms r17/r18, the eye and the rear block all sit where the sprite has them. The diff in panel 4 shows red only at the small dark wing-tip wedges under each wing block (r55, coverage 0.26; r31, 0.75) and along the bevelled ends. Colour misses are local: the turret caps r0/r1 (dE 16) and the small blocks r13/r20 (dE 27) are darker than the sprite's light grey, the eye highlight r22 is off (dE 19.6), and the near-black claw shapes r7/r14 come out dark grey with pale blue patches. Fix the wedges and those colours and it's a 5.
reasons.volume: The whole 180 x 76 px ship is 0 to 7.9 px tall (h/w 0.064). The flat plates are about right for flat parts: the deck r2 at ~4 px (analysis 3.7), the pods r11 at 4.8 px and the panels r24/r25 at 3.4 px. Every round part is about half height or less: the arms r17/r18 are 4.6 px mean (5.4 max) against ~8-11 inferred, the U-bar r28 tops out at 5.1 px (8.5 inferred), the eye r9 at 7.75 px (12.4 inferred), and the lower engines r41-r43 at 2.3-3.4 px (7.4-9.5 inferred). Opus gave 2 and Fable 3; I took 3 because the rubric's 3 is exactly 'some parts right, others too flat', though it's a low 3. Target: arms and U-bar ~10 px above the 4 px deck, the eye ~12 px, the engines ~8 px.

issues.note: The glass dome r0 (and r56 on the lower copy) is a low lens, crowning at about 4-6 px over a footprint about 55 px across. It should be an egg-shaped dome about 25 px tall (at least half its width; Opus suggested 25-30, Fable 20-24), taller toward the sprite's top. It should meet the cobbles at the sprite's purple rim and keep the specular highlight upper-left.

The city towers (r1, r2, r20 and the small tower regions r3-r16; r57-r76 on the lower copy) are flat tiles 3-8 px tall lying like a mosaic. They should be upright rectangular prisms with vertical facades: the tall centre towers about 20-24 px, the ring of smaller ones 10-16 px, stepping down toward the dome edge.

The towers poke through the glass: their tops reach about 8 px while the dome crown is about 4-6 px, so in panels 7-9 the city sits on top of a lens instead of inside a bubble. Every tower must sit fully inside the shell. Raise the dome to about 25 px and keep the tallest tower a few px below it.

From above the glass reads grey-silver, with purple only at the rim. The sprite's glass is deep violet with a lilac highlight and a darker purple rim. Darken and saturate the glass material toward violet, keep it translucent so the towers show through, and let lighting make the highlight.

The towers are uniform flat slate grey (dE about 14, r5/r8 about 21). In the sprite they're dark blue-teal, with pale cyan lit faces on their upper-left sides (r3, r4, r9, r10) and scattered cyan/white window pixels. Use a dark teal material, lighten the upper-left faces, and add emissive or shallow inset window rows.
The cobble ground plates are dull grey-brown. The sprite's cobbles are warm orange-brown with dark gaps, so warm the plate colour toward the sprite's.

On the lower-right the dome rim flattens into a purple ledge or skirt instead of curving down into the ground. Keep the shell's curve continuous all the way to the cobbles (it should follow from rebuilding the dome).

reasons.cohesion: The seam metrics are clean (mean dz 0.005 px, max 0.24 px, none over 1 px; the 78 gap samples aren't visible), and the ground plates and the overlapping second tile meet without steps. The fit error is between the towers and the glass: the tower tops (6-8 px) stand above the glass crown (4-6 px), so in panels 7-9 the tower slabs poke through the shell instead of sitting inside it. Fable gave 4 and Opus 3; I scored 3 because the poke-through is clearly visible from the game camera.
reasons.detail: The skyline is broken into individual tower blocks of varying footprint, and the cobble ground has per-stone relief, so the main details are there. Missing: the pale cyan lit faces and window rows on the towers (sprite r3, r4, r9, r10), so the city reads as uniform grey boxes, and the dark alley gaps (r17/r26/r30) exist only as floor between blocks. The dome has a specular highlight upper-left. Opus gave 2 (towers present in footprint but not as buildings) and Fable 3; I scored 3 because the blocks and cobbles are real relief, while the heights are already counted under volume.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it's recognisable as the domed city: the tower cluster, the purple rim and the cobble plate are all there. But it reads as a tray of grey boxes sticking up out of a low shell with a purple skirt, not a tall violet glass bubble over a skyline. Raising the dome and towers and fixing the glass tint would fix most of this.
reasons.overall: Outline, colour placement and piece fit at the base are good, but the two parts that define the sprite, a tall glass dome and a skyline inside it, are both about a quarter of their proper height, and the towers break through the glass. It needs a volume rebuild (dome about 25 px, towers 10-24 px inside it), then the purple glass and lit teal towers. Poor as it stands, so 2.
reasons.profile: The glass is curved but it's a low lens or saucer (about 5 px over about 55 px), where the sprite's highlight and dark rim show a tall egg-shaped bubble. Fable also notes the rim flattens into a ledge on the lower-right instead of curving down to the cobbles. The towers are flat-topped boxes, which is the right shape for buildings, but at 3-8 px they read as overlapping tiles lying on the glass, like a mosaic (panels 7-8). The flat cobble plates are right. Target: a true egg/hemisphere shell enclosing upright rectangular prisms.
reasons.silhouette: The outline is near-exact (IoU 0.995, 28 px missed, 24 extra of 10106): both egg-shaped domes, their tower clusters and the square cobble plates line up with the sprite (panels 3-4). The colour is what's off (dE 10.3 mean, r5/r8 about 21). From above (panel 2) the glass reads grey-silver with only a purple rim, where the sprite's glass is deep violet. The towers are flat slate grey where the sprite's are dark blue-teal with pale cyan lit faces and window pixels, and the cobbles are grey-brown where the sprite's are warm orange-brown. Fable gave 4 and Opus 3; I scored 3 because the colour of all three main materials is visibly off even though the outline is perfect.
reasons.volume: Everything except the ground is about a quarter of the height it should be. On the panel 5/6 rulers the glass shell (r0/r56) rises only about 4-6 px over a footprint about 55 px across, and the tallest tower tops reach 8.2 px (max_height 8.16, h/w 0.085). A dome should stand at least half its width, so about 25 px (Opus said 25-30, Fable 20-24). The sprite draws the towers' facades as skyscrapers, so they should be roughly 10-24 px, tallest in the middle. Only the cobble plates (r18/r74, r24/r80 at about 0.6 px) are correctly flat. Opus gave 1 and Fable 2; I went with 1 because both defining parts are uniformly far too low.

issues.note: Every member loses the sprite's edge pixels (IoU 0.433, 102 of 180 px missed). The rails r4/r6 and the arch band r0 are about 1-1.5 px wide against the sprite's 3 px, and the pod r7 is about 4-5 px against about 6 px. Widen each part to its sprite pixel width (rails and arch about 3 px, pod about 6 px), and check that the rail bottoms reach the sprite's last row.

The rails r4 (left) and r6 (right) are boards about 1.4 px wide and about 4.4 px tall, standing on edge. The sprite draws them 3 px wide with dark sides and a lit centre, so they should be round tubes about 3 px in diameter (about 3 px tall).

The arch r0 is a tan ribbon about 1-1.5 px wide and about 4 px tall, standing on edge. In the sprite it's a 3 px band (tan centre, black edges), so it should be a round tube about 3 px in diameter, following the arch curve and continuous with the rails.

The pod r7 is a uniform, darker mid-brown (dE 20.3). The sprite's pod is lighter tan, with a pale tan highlight stripe down its left-centre and dark brown to black on the lower right. Lighten the base toward the sprite's tan, and add the light stripe and the darker lower panel.
The axle struts between the pod and the rails are hair-thin rods (about 0.5 px). The sprite draws them as 2 px dark-grey stubs, so make them round struts about 1.5-2 px thick.

The right arch corners r3 and r5 (dE 29-35) are tan on the model, but in the sprite those corner pixels are dark brown where the arch meets the rail. Darken those corners, and add the arch's alternating tan/brown segment banding along r0. (Fable's call for light-grey corners doesn't match the sprite at r3/r5.)
The sprite's pod shows 2-3 vertical bands (pale, mid and dark columns). Add them as lighter stripes or shallow raised ribs (about 0.3-0.5 px) running down the capsule.

reasons.detail: The dark clamp collars on both rails at the sprite's two dark bands, the axle stubs joining pod and rails, and the nozzle are all modelled. Missing: the arch's alternating tan/brown segment banding, and the pod's pale vertical highlight stripe(s) and dark lower panel. The main details are there, so 3.
reasons.game: From the game camera (panel 9) it reads as a pod hanging in an arched frame, recognisably the sprite's horseshoe-with-pod layout. But the frame looks spindly and plank-like rather than the sprite's chunky tubed frame, and the pod is darker than the sprite's tan. Recognisable, so 3.
reasons.overall: Right parts in the right arrangement, at the wrong width: the rails and arch are about a third to half of their sprite width and shaped as boards instead of tubes, and the pod is about 1 px too narrow, which halves the IoU. Widening and rounding the frame would fix most of it; the pod colour and corner colours are secondary. Poor for now, so 2.
reasons.profile: The pod r7 is a proper rounded capsule with a nozzle hole, which is right. The rails r4/r6 are thin rectangular boards on edge, and the arch r0 is a flat ribbon on edge (panels 7-8). The sprite's dark-sides/light-centre shading says round tubes about 3 px in diameter, continuous from the rails around the arch. The axle struts are hair-thin rods. Mixed, mostly wrong, so 2.
reasons.silhouette: The layout is right: a tan arch (r0), two grey rails (r4 left, r6 right) and a central pod (r7) on a crossbar.
